title: Specification of a successful split
statement: For natural numbers $C,c,m,n$, if the exponential-split search on $(C,c,m)$ returns $n$, then $n\le m$ and $n+C\cdot 2^{(n+1)^c}=m$.
replaced:
If the exponential-split search on $(C, c, m)$ returns $n$, then $n \le m$ and
$n + C \cdot 2^{(n+1)^c} = m$.
